scene: Following the zeppelin, you reach Observatory Hill's bustling transit terrace.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a stone transit promenade. On the far left, a red monorail train sits at an open platform. In the centre, a pedal rickshaw waits by a wooden bench. The elderly man in his orange cardigan stands mid-right with his cane. On the far right, a turquoise water taxi bobs beside steps.
shown: a sleek red monorail car waiting with open doors on the far left
a wheeled rickshaw with a nodding driver parked at centre
a turquoise water taxi tied to a dock on the far right
